description: Enhance Google Antigravity in VS Code: right-click files/folders to chat, right-click editor selections to chat, and drag-and-drop files directly into the chat window.
cmd.addCurrentFileToChat: Add Current File to Antigravity Chat
cmd.enableDragAndDrop: Enable File Drag-and-Drop to Antigravity Chat
cmd.disableDragAndDrop: Disable File Drag-and-Drop to Antigravity Chat (Restore Original)
config.autoEnableDragAndDrop: Automatically patch the Google Antigravity extension to allow dragging and dropping files/folders directly into the Antigravity chat window.
